summary: First-pass testing of Agnes Motion Studio. Backend: 5/6 pytest tests pass. One real backend bug: /api/agnes/validate incorrectly reports bogus keys as valid because the Agnes /models endpoint is public (returns 200 without auth). Frontend: API-key validation UI, random theme, category filters, theme selection, prompt/duration/aspect-ratio selectors, and the generate button all work. The backend storyboard call succeeds. BUT the <StoryboardTimeline> component crashes with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading accent)' because it reads s.style.accent / s.style.bg[1] on each scene while buildProject() never attaches a `style` to scenes (theme palette lives at project.theme.palette). This single bug blocks everything downstream: scene cards never render, timeline never renders, video player cannot be driven, scene-3 seek cannot be tested, export cannot be tested. Needs retest after fix.

critical.issue: Bogus API keys are reported as {valid:true}. Root cause: the Agnes AI /v1/models endpoint returns HTTP 200 without any Authorization header (confirmed by curl with 'Bearer bad-key' -> 200 + full model list). The validate route uses /models as its probe, so authentication is never actually verified. Fix: probe with a tiny POST to /v1/chat/completions (max_tokens:1) and treat 200 as valid / 401 as invalid, OR keep /models but also perform the chat probe before returning valid:true.

ui_bugs.issue: Runtime error 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading accent)'. The component references s.style.accent and s.style.bg[1] on every scene, but /app/frontend/src/lib/storyboard.js -> buildProject() does NOT attach a `style` field to scenes. The theme palette is at project.theme.palette (keys: primary, secondary, accent, text, bgDark). Fix either (a) attach a per-scene style in buildProject (e.g. style: { accent: theme.palette.accent, bg: [theme.palette.bgDark, theme.palette.primary] }) or (b) in StoryboardTimeline, destructure project.theme and use project.theme.palette.accent / palette.primary / palette.bgDark directly instead of s.style.*. This bug blocks ALL downstream flows (scene cards, timeline, video player, export).

integration_issues.issue: Backend returns a valid storyboard (confirmed via API test); the frontend receives it and buildProject runs, but rendering of StoryboardTimeline then throws (see UI bug above). Progress tracker reaches final step but UI crashes before cards appear.
Could not be tested because the storyboard crash prevents the player/export panel from becoming functional. Needs retest after the StoryboardTimeline bug is fixed.

action_items: FIX FRONTEND CRITICAL: StoryboardTimeline.jsx references s.style.accent/s.style.bg[1] which do not exist. Either attach style per scene in buildProject() or read from project.theme.palette directly in the component. This is blocking all downstream UI tests.

FIX BACKEND: /api/agnes/validate must actually verify the key. The /v1/models endpoint of Agnes AI is public (returns 200 without auth). Switch the primary probe to a 1-token chat/completions call, or chain /models + chat probe.
Update backend test to reflect: once validate is fixed, test_invalid_key will pass as-is (expects valid:false).
critical_code_review_comments: StoryboardTimeline couples to a non-existent `scene.style` schema. buildProject does not attach any theme-derived style per scene -- component and data model are out of sync.
/api/agnes/validate relies on a public endpoint for authentication. This is a security/UX bug: any arbitrary string is reported as a valid key.
No React error boundary around the studio tree -- any component throw blanks the whole page; adding a boundary would at least surface a graceful fallback (nice-to-have).

rca of the issue: Frontend crash RCA: /app/frontend/src/components/studio/StoryboardTimeline.jsx lines 48 & 77 read `s.style.accent` and `s.style.bg[1]`. /app/frontend/src/lib/storyboard.js buildProject() maps scenes to {id,index,role,label,start,end,duration,headline,subtext,keywords} -- no `style`. Repro: enter valid key, pick any theme, fill prompt, click Generate, wait ~5s -> runtime error overlay 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading accent)'. Mitigation: attach style per scene from project.theme.palette in buildProject OR consume project.theme.palette directly in StoryboardTimeline. Backend validate RCA: curl https://apihub.agnes-ai.com/v1/models -H 'Authorization: Bearer bad-key' returns HTTP 200 + model list. Mitigation: use chat/completions probe (max_tokens:1) which does require a valid key (401 for bad).
